The Shag features a Tonebender MKII circuit in a copy of the larger MKI enclosure, with a few modern upgrades including true-bypass. NOS Parts with NPN Germanium Transistors for that classic Germanium Fuzz tone. This three-transistor build delivers a fuzz circuit that hass a very rich, harmonic sound with a lot of gain. 9V Battery or 2.1 9V Adapter Only. Hand-wired and handmade by the one-man-band at Stomp Under Foot.
